items.title: Audit local AI agents safely
items.oneliner: Single-command scanner reveals every local AI agent, its permissions, and what files or tools it can touch.

items.title: Explore anatomy in the browser
items.oneliner: React and Three.js anatomy explorer ships 2,234 selectable meshes and 3,400 concepts with no account required.

items.title: Run GNU Radio in browser
items.oneliner: WebAssembly port runs GNU Radio flowgraphs in-browser with live spectrum plots and WebUSB support for SDR hardware.

items.title: Build an e-ink network printer
items.oneliner: Hands-on walkthrough shows how to implement IPP, Bonjour discovery, and memory-mapped rendering for a custom e-ink printer.

items.title: Rewrite scooter firmware in Rust
items.oneliner: Detailed reverse-engineering log covers Bluetooth updates, hidden telemetry, and custom Rust firmware for an e-scooter.

items.title: Stream HTML without JavaScript
items.oneliner: Practical SSR tutorial shows progressive HTML streaming, form handling, and interactivity using only server-rendered primitives.

items.title: Cut ClickHouse queries below one second
items.oneliner: Real optimization case study walks through partitioning and engine fixes that dropped query latency from minutes to sub-second.

items.title: Benchmark code counters with strace
items.oneliner: Useful microbenchmark compares scc and mezura, then uses strace to explain a 2.56x performance gap.

items.title: Speed up Emacs Consult searches
items.oneliner: Concrete Emacs tuning guide shows which async debounce and refresh settings make ripgrep-backed searches feel much faster.

items.title: Get a free arpa domain
